cockpit.purpose: Dense operator control, live state, routes and telemetry.

studio.purpose: Creative workspaces where the canvas stays visually authoritative.

dashboard.purpose: Readable overview, discovery, growth and navigation.

lab.purpose: Experiments, evidence, comparison and bounded inspection.

boundaries: A profile changes presentation, never permissions or runtime authority.
Visual readiness is not aesthetic approval.
Reduced-motion and narrow-screen fallbacks are mandatory.
Migration reports are advice and never rewrite a host automatically.
